summary: Practise talent calibration, GROW coaching and IDP planning for high-potential employees. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Developing high-potential employees means using role evidence to guide growth toward broader responsibilities. For HR business partners, talent managers and line leaders, the course covers reviewing nominations, calibrating readiness with the 9-box grid, and planning stretch assignments and SMART milestones. It also develops GROW coaching and SBI feedback skills, with tools for tracking progress and summarizing succession readiness.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who identify, develop or coach employees with potential for broader responsibilities. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical ways to review evidence, shape development and follow up on progress.
prerequisites: This foundation-level course assumes no specialist coaching or psychometric qualification. Programming is not required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for the talent-calibration matrix and IDP tracker exercises.
